final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT c.SupportRepId AS rep_id, e.City AS city, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Customer AS c JOIN Employee AS e ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY c.SupportRepId, e.City), s2 AS (SELECT city, AVG(n) AS avg_n FROM s1 GROUP BY city), s3 AS (SELECT s1.rep_id, s1.city, s1.n, s1.n - s2.avg_n AS difference FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s1.city COLLATE BINARY = s2.city COLLATE BINARY WHERE s1.n > s2.avg_n), s4 AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS total_n FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.city, s3.n, s3.difference, CAST(s3.n AS REAL) / s4.total_n AS share FROM s3 CROSS JOIN s4 WHERE s4.total_n IS NOT NULL) SELECT city, SUM(n), AVG(difference), AVG(share) FROM s5 GROUP BY city
